source: docs/PHOTO_GATE_RUNBOOK.md §3 (501-image val ROC + P/R memo, 2026-09-29 retrain) and docs/PHOTO_GATE_RELIABILITY_REPORT.md §3 (first-24h canary baseline)
note: p_reject is the classifier's non-garbage probability. The canary uploads the SAME byte-identical probe every sweep, so its logged p_reject is deterministic for a given model + preprocessing + threshold. A shift in the live canary distribution therefore means the shipped model, its preprocessing, or the operating threshold changed unexpectedly.
